hook: A light, list-driven entry: a sports radio show from another universe, covering a version of baseball far more violent and strange than ours. Most of the article is a team-by-team table, and nearly every row is a one-line joke. You don't need to know baseball well, but knowing the real major-league clubs makes the parallels much funnier.
whyItMatters: SCP-2206 shows the wiki's comedic side done in a dry, encyclopedic voice; the humor comes from deadpan presentation rather than from winking at the reader. The containment section is a joke in itself, since the Foundation's answer is to dress the broadcasts up as a fictional parody show, merchandise included.
thingsToNotice: Read the notes column against the real-world counterpart column: many entries take a team's actual name or nickname and turn it into a literal fact. Several rows connect to each other, so a feud or relocation mentioned in one team's notes reappears in another's. The footnotes add a second layer of deadpan, calmly correcting facts about our world as if it were the odd one out.
